Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent transparent achievement icon in a cozy pastoral mobile game's sheep badge family.
Primary request: Create ONE standalone icon, not a collection sheet, UI, or sprite atlas.
Style/medium: genuinely chunky pixel-art sprite designed like a simple 32x32 pixel icon enlarged without smoothing. Warm cream wool, peach faces, orange-brown thick stepped outer contour, dark brown dot eyes, and small green botanical accents. A very small palette of flat warm colors with hard block transitions. Cute round sheep shapes, bold and immediately recognizable when reduced to 28 pixels. Use large square pixel clusters and very few small details. The icon must match the existing friendly cream-sheep pastoral achievement series.
Composition: compact centered square silhouette with fully transparent margin on all four sides, about 80 percent canvas occupancy. Subject never touches or clips the canvas edges. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the subjects. No background, scenic view, floor, ground slab, decorative badge backing, outer frame, or border.
Text: none; no words, numbers, lettering, labels, watermark, UI or captions.
Avoid: smooth gradients, glow, blur, antialiased vector strokes, painterly grain, tiny thin outlines, intricate detail, glossy 3D, photorealism.
Subject: One adorable cream-white fluffy sheep taking a little forward step, wearing a small sky-blue scarf. Beside it are exactly two simple terracotta-brown hoofprints and a small green grass tuft. Readable walking pose with a simple compact silhouette.
